dialogue.content: こんばんは今日は、相談者役をありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for playing the role of the client today.

dialogue.content: こんばんはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: We'll begin when it's time. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 了解ですお願いします
dialogue.English: Understood. Please go ahead.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。本日はどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。よろしければ、まず初めにご年齢と性別をお知らせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you today. If you don't mind, could we start with your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんばんはよろしくお願いします４８才　女性です
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's nice to meet you. I'm a 48-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: はいご近所さんとかの物音などが気になって不快感があるんです
dialogue.English: Well, I've been feeling distressed because noises from my neighbors and the area have been bothering me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、、、それはストレスも溜まりそうですね…
dialogue.English: I see... That sounds like it could build up a lot of stress...

dialogue.content: いつ頃から気になられているのですか？
dialogue.English: How long has this been bothering you?

dialogue.content: そうなんですいろいろと敏感タイプで、不快な物音などストレスが積み重なっていて…新築一戸建てで引っ越してきて、１８年なんですが…
dialogue.English: Yes, I tend to be sensitive to various things, and the stress from unpleasant noises has been piling up... We moved into a newly built detached house, and it’s been 18 years.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…それは本当にお辛いですね…引っ越された当初から悩まれているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very difficult for you. Have you been struggling with this ever since you moved in?

dialogue.content: 最初は、「まぁいろいろあるな…」くらいだったんですが、長年の積み重ねで、意外にストレスたまってるなと最近気付きました
dialogue.English: At first, I just thought, "Well, these things happen..." but with it building up over many years, I've recently realized how much stress has actually accumulated.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…ちょっとしたことでも長い間我慢されていたとなると、とても苦しくなってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand... Having to endure even small things for such a long time can become very painful, can't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです自覚してなかっただけに、たまるんですよね
dialogue.English: Exactly. Since I wasn't consciously aware of it, it just kept piling up.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね…本当にお辛いですよね…例えば、どんな音に不快感を感じられているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I hear you... It must be truly difficult. For example, what kinds of sounds do you find distressing?

dialogue.content: はいうちの南側のおうちがですね…若い主婦の方が幼児二人に頻繁に怒鳴ってるのが聞こえてきて…しばらくすると、離婚で引っ越したら、次に…
dialogue.English: Yes, the house to our south... I could often hear a young mother yelling at her two toddlers... After a while they moved out due to a divorce, and then the next...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: きた家族の年配のご主人が、咳やらタンを吐くとか朝の
dialogue.English: The older husband in the family that moved in... coughs and spits up phlegm in the morning—

dialogue.content: ６時半くらいに毎朝３０分気持ち悪い音が…
dialogue.English: Every morning around 6:30, for about 30 minutes, there are these disgusting sounds...

dialogue.content: 毎朝　毎朝聞こえてきて気の毒なんですが
dialogue.English: I hear it every single morning, and I do feel sorry for him, but—

dialogue.content: 本当に不快なんです
dialogue.English: it's truly unpleasant.

dialogue.content: ええ…そうなんですね！それは…不快に思われて当然と感じます。
dialogue.English: Yes... I see. It's completely reasonable that you would feel uncomfortable about that.

dialogue.content: うちの東西南北四方からいろいろな騒音があるんです
dialogue.English: There are various noises coming from all four directions around my house—east, west, south, and north.

dialogue.content: 南側のお家だけじゃないのですね…。「ちょっとしたこと」でもないように感じますね。
dialogue.English: So it’s not just the house to the south... It doesn’t sound like a “small thing” at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんです時間帯様々でいろいろな騒音があって、いつの間にかストレスです
dialogue.English: That's right. There are all sorts of noises at various times of the day, and before I knew it, it became a source of stress.

dialogue.content: ええ、それはお悩みにもなりますよね。体調はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I can see how that would become a problem. How has your health been?

dialogue.content: はい元々、私には持病のような体調不調があり、騒音のストレスも原因の１つかもです
dialogue.English: Well, I already have a chronic health condition, and the stress from the noise might be one of the causes.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…それでは本当に長い間苦しかったですね…最近、それらの音がストレスだったと気づかれた、とおしゃってましたが、気づいたきっかけはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see... You must have been suffering for a very long time... You mentioned that you recently realized these noises were a source of stress. Was there anything that triggered that realization?

dialogue.content: 長年の間に騒音が増えてきて…西側のおうちが頻繁にうちの隣すぐで、バーベキューをするんですが…ある日、深夜１１時まで大騒ぎしてたんです庭で。
dialogue.English: The noise has increased over the years... The house to the west of us often has barbecues right next to our property, and one day, they were making a huge racket in their yard until 11 PM.

dialogue.content: えっ！それは…
dialogue.English: Oh! That’s...

dialogue.content: 煙やにおいだけでなく、深夜まで、、、苦情など伝えたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Not just the smoke and smell, but late into the night... Did you complain to them about it?

dialogue.content: うるさいな…って思ってたら、南側の早朝咳でうるさいおじさんが、バーベキューメンバー　分譲地4軒の夫婦達　に「いい加減にしろ」って怒鳴って、深夜だけはなくなったんです
dialogue.English: I was thinking how noisy it was... when the man from the south side, the one with the loud morning cough, yelled "That's enough!" at the barbecue group—which was made up of couples from four houses in the development—and at least the late-night noise stopped.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。確かに他の近隣の方にも迷惑ですからね。深夜だけはなくなったということは、バーベキューはまだされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It certainly must have been a nuisance to other neighbors as well. So, if only the late-night parties stopped, does that mean they still have barbecues?

dialogue.content: 私は、同じ年代だけに、言うと後が怖いので言えません…かなりのバーベキュー好きなので、その家族だけでのバーベキューも頻繁で、匂いがきつくて洗濯物に匂いうつってます
dialogue.English: Since we're of a similar age, I'm afraid of the aftermath if I say something, so I can't... They're fanatical about barbecuing, so even when it's just their family, they do it frequently, and the smell is so strong it gets on my laundry.

dialogue.content: ええ、昼間であったとしても、隣の庭でのバーベキューは困りますよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, even if it's during the day, having a barbecue in the yard right next door would be troublesome.

dialogue.content: そうなんです住宅地で隣接してますからね
dialogue.English: Exactly. We’re in a residential area with the houses so close together.

dialogue.content: それに、近隣の方に苦情を言うのをためらわれるのもごもっともだと思います。それらをずっと我慢されてきたのですね…！
dialogue.English: And I think it's completely understandable that you'd hesitate to complain to your neighbors. You've been enduring all of this for so long...!

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは同居のご家族はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have family living with you?

dialogue.content: はい、主人と今は高校生の息子ひとりと同居で。その四家族は、息子より年上で、何か言うといじめられるかもしれません。今は、もう高校生なので大丈夫ですが…
dialogue.English: Yes, I live with my husband and my son, who is in high school now. The children from those four families are older than my son, and I was worried he might get bullied if I said something. He's in high school now, so it should be fine, but...

dialogue.content: ↑四家族には、2〜3人　子供がいます
dialogue.English: Each of those four families has two or three children.

dialogue.content: なるほど…お子さま同士の付き合いなども考えて我慢されてきたのですね。お子さまをとても大切に育てられているのが伝わります。
dialogue.English: I see... So you've been putting up with it while considering your son's relationships with the other children. I can tell you've raised your son with great care.

dialogue.content: それらの騒音などについて、ご家族とは相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you discussed these noise issues with your family?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。通学班や子供会で付き合いがありますから…
dialogue.English: Thank you. We have ties through the school commuting groups and the children’s association, so...

dialogue.content: あと北側も問題が…
dialogue.English: And there’s also a problem on the north side...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなのですね。どんなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Oh, is that so? What kind of problem is it?

dialogue.content: 主人も不快に思っているようですが、何かするタイプではないんです北側はですね…
dialogue.English: My husband seems to find it unpleasant too, but he’s not the type to take action. As for the north side...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 毎日昼頃、そこのおうちの車が、１時間近く、アイドリング　エンジンかけっぱなしで、ガソリンの匂いが、洗面所に入ってくるんです
dialogue.English: Every day around noon, their car is left idling—with the engine running—for nearly an hour, and the smell of gasoline comes into our washroom.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか。それもとても不快ですね…！
dialogue.English: Is that right? That must be very unpleasant as well!

dialogue.content: そうなんです帰宅してエンジンかけてエアコンかけて、幼児を車で昼寝させたり、ビデオみせたりして、そこのお母さんは、うちの中で家事してるんです
dialogue.English: That's right. She comes home, turns on the engine and the air conditioning, and has her toddler nap or watch videos in the car while she does housework inside her own home.

dialogue.content: では、そのこともやめてくださいというようなことは言わず、我慢されているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, have you been enduring that as well, without asking them to stop?

dialogue.content: さらに夏は頻繁に庭で音楽かけて、プールで水遊びさせて…それらもなかなか言えず…
dialogue.English: And in the summer, they frequently play music in their yard and let their kids play in a pool... and I can't bring myself to say anything about that either...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…体調が悪くなられるのも無理はないのではないかと感じました。
dialogue.English: I see... It’s no wonder your health has been affected.

dialogue.content: では、本日のご相談は、これらの騒音に対して何かできることはないかを考えるということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, for today's session, would it be correct to say that you'd like to think about what, if anything, can be done about these noise issues?

dialogue.content: 違ったら遠慮なく言ってくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please don't hesitate to correct me if I'm wrong.

dialogue.content: そうなんですいつのまにかかなり音に敏感になってました東側の畑の草刈機の音も気になるようになってきて…
dialogue.English: That's right. Before I knew it, I’d become quite sensitive to sounds; even the noise of the mower in the field to the east has started to bother me...

dialogue.content: ええ、気になりだすと、どんどん気になりますよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, once something starts to bother you, it tends to bother you more and more, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 考えていたただけてうれしいですでもどうしようもないですよね…
dialogue.English: I’m glad you’re willing to think this through with me. But there’s nothing that can be done, is there...

dialogue.content: そうですね…けれど、バーベキューや車のアイドリングなどについては、ひとつできることはあるのではないかなと思いました。お伝えしても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's a fair point... however, regarding the barbecues and the car idling, I thought there might be one thing you could do. Would it be all right if I shared it with you?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 一度、自治体に相談されてみてはいかがかなと思いました。騒音などの苦情を取り扱う部署がありますので、誰から、とはわからないように、対応をしてくださると思います。
dialogue.English: I was thinking, how about consulting your local municipality? They have departments that handle complaints about noise and other issues, and I believe they can respond in a way that keeps your identity anonymous.

dialogue.content: かといって、それで止めてくださるかどうかはわかりませんが、あまり迷惑かけていると意識せずにされている方もいますので、気が付くことで辞めてくださる場合もあります。
dialogue.English: Now, that's not to say it will guarantee they'll stop, but some people are simply unaware of the trouble they're causing, so they might stop once they realize it.

dialogue.content: そうですね…バーベキューのことは、うち以外にも関わりがあるおうちがあるので良いのですが、アイドリングは、うちだけの被害なので…しかもそこの主婦の方、あとがけっこう怖そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's true... The barbecue issue affects other houses besides ours, so that might be okay, but the idling only affects us... Besides, the woman there seems like she could be intimidating to deal with afterward.

dialogue.content: 市役所に電話すればいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Should I call City Hall?

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それも含めて、注意していただくかどうかはよく相談されるといいと思います。他の口実でお話しすることなどもできるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I see. Including that point, it would be good to consult with them carefully about whether and how to issue a warning. They might be able to approach the matter under a different pretext.

dialogue.content: ええ、お住いの地域の自治体の代表電話で、近所の騒音などの相談と伝えれば、担当につなげてくださると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, if you call the main line for your local municipal office and say you'd like to consult about neighborhood noise, I think they'll connect you to the right department.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！アイドリングは子供さんたちが大きくなったらおさまるとは思うので、しばらくまた様子みて考えてみますね！ありがとうございます!
dialogue.English: I see! I think the idling will probably stop once their children get older, so I'll wait and see for a while longer and then think about it. Thank you!

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。状況を冷静に判断していらっしゃるのですね！そのように、今しばらくの期間のことだろうと考えられるは、素晴らしいと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. You're assessing the situation very calmly! I think it's wonderful that you can see it as something that will likely only last for a little while longer.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！そういえば、実家（子供時代）でも隣接の町工場の騒音が相当うるさかったので、音にはずっと悩まされてます
dialogue.English: Thank you! Come to think of it, at my parents' house when I was a child, the noise from the small factory next door was also incredibly loud, so I've been plagued by noise for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうですか…。子供時代からのこともあって、音に敏感になられているのでしょうか…。他にも自治体に相談してもどうもできないこともあるかと思いますが、まずは音がストレスだと気が付かれたことは大きな一歩ですね。
dialogue.English: Is that so... Perhaps your childhood experiences have contributed to your sensitivity to sound... There may be other issues that the municipality can't resolve, but just realizing that the noise is a source of stress is a huge first step.

dialogue.content: そうですね！今日は、お話聴いていただけてよかったです！今まで誰にも言ってなかったので…
dialogue.English: You're right! I'm so glad I could talk to you about this today! I've never told anyone about this before...

dialogue.content: そうですか。そう言っていただけて嬉しいです。相談者さまはとても我慢強いのですね。ストレスの原因がわかったことで、ご自身で不快な音を遮るためにできる対策もあるかもしれないと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that so? I'm happy to hear you say that. You are very patient. Now that you've identified the source of your stress, do you think there might be measures you could take yourself to block out the unpleasant sounds?

dialogue.content: そうですね一時的に窓を閉めたりしてますので…後は、音楽かけたりしてみます
dialogue.English: That's true. I already close the windows temporarily sometimes... I'll also try playing some music.

dialogue.content: それはいいですね！
dialogue.English: That's a great idea!

dialogue.content: はい、今日は本当にありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you so much for today!

dialogue.content: では、お時間となってしまったのですが、また、別の相談員でもこの続きの話をすることができます。
dialogue.English: Well, our time is up for today, but you can continue this discussion with another counselor in the future if you'd like.

dialogue.content: はい、またお願いするかもです
dialogue.English: Yes, I might just do that.

dialogue.content: ええ、もしよろしければ、また、その後のことでもお話にいらしてください。本日は相談にいらしてくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, please feel free to come and talk with us again, even just to give an update. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。（お疲れ様でした）
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。忌憚ない評価のほどよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your work. We would appreciate your frank evaluation.)
